name: Auth config tamper: sudoers/PAM (Linux, auditd)
description: Write to /etc/sudoers(.d) or /etc/pam.d|/etc/pam.conf seen by the auditd sudoers_tamper/pam_tamper watches. Catches in-place edits Defend's Linux file events miss (echo-append to sudoers = T1548.003/5, sed PAM rule insert = T1556.003/1).
query: file where host.os.type == "linux" and event.dataset == "auditd_manager.auditd" and (file.path like "/etc/sudoers*" or file.path like "/etc/pam.d/*" or file.path == "/etc/pam.conf")
